about: Round 0 approves u1 and sends u2 to round 1. The re-check's findings carry a missed entry, which a re-check may not have, so `findings` refuses. After the retries, the session runs `findings --failed`: u2, the unit in fixing, is undone from the round 1 record, so its round 1 copy leaves idea-mara. u1 stays approved and its copy stays. One batch, so the run ends at batches-done.
